steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: How could this be...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What in the world... is going on here?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Search all these houses! I want every single room turned inside out!

steps.name: Female
steps.text: Let go of me...! No! You can't...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Trying to resist? Too late, you filthy Chernos!

steps.name: Male
steps.text: Just run! Don't worry about me... Save... our child...

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Mama... Mama...!

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: Forget about the civilians! Hold the line first! There are too many masked goons coming!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't give the cops any time to rest! Keep attacking!

steps.name: Ursus Guard
steps.text: Where are our reinforcements?! We're going to get overrun...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Attack, attack!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's going on...? ! Why... Why is Reunion doing this...?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: After all these years, the wolves in sheep's clothing finally bare their fangs.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: The Infected... they, they're attacking the Ursus troops!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But why?! Challenging the Ursus government like this is basically suicide!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No, look at how fierce this attack is. This must have been a planned operation.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The place we rescued Doctor from was supposed to be top secret... but they somehow still managed to infiltrate it.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's possible that Reunion's attack has already spread through Chernobog in its entirety.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: No... How, how can that be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Shhhh!

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Have you found any of those fleeing Chernos yet?

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: I'm still looking!

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Good, don't let a single one get away!

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Those cold-blooded beasts... I'll make them pay for what they did to my family!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: (*cough*)

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: Over there!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: (Mmfh!)

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: (They... they found us...)

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: (Shush!)

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Over here! I found 'em!

steps.name: Female
steps.text: ...Nooooo!!!!

steps.name: Female
steps.text: Aaah! No, don't...

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: Hiding in an alley?

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: Get out.

steps.name: Female
steps.text: Aaaaahh...!

steps.name: Reunion Member B
steps.text: Did you really think we wouldn't find you there...?

steps.name: Female
steps.text: I'm... I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!! Please, at least spare my child!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...We need to stop this, now.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm aware of the risk, Instructor Dobermann.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just that... we don't have the luxury of sitting around waiting for Reunion to disband.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Additionally, nobody knows how long this situation will last...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Therefore, the best course of action would be to take out the enemy and then get moving. Wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Understood. I'll follow your command.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All squads, listen up.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We have the element of surprise - these Reunion members don't know that we're here yet.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Remember, be decisive! Take them out, cleanly and swiftly.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, gather your team. It's time for you to prove yourself.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We have no more time to second-guess ourselves.

options: You should have told me sooner.
A simple matter. I'll handle this.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amiya, I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'Silent we shall be, should conflict be avoidable--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: --but fight tooth and nail, should it be necessary!'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island's creed... has always been the same!
